Schmelzender LEGO-Stiftständer

https://makerworld.com/de/models/1293993-melting-leg0-pen-holder#profileId-1324715

The work represents a red brick, similar to those used in children's games, which is melting on a dark surface. From the center of the brick comes out a ballpoint pen with a blue cap, as if it had been stuck inside.

The contrast between the world of play (the brick) and that of writing (the pen) creates an original and curious image. It is a visual reflection on how creativity can arise both from play and from written expression, mixing childhood and adult life.

The strong colors and clean style make the image impactful, perfect for those who love simple but meaningful design.

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#000000)
